steps.title: Configure memory and private context separately
steps.code:
env: { ...env,
  HOME: dirs.home, USERPROFILE: dirs.home,
  CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: dirs.sdkHome,
  CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY: "1",
  ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS: "false"
},
steps.explanation: Source filtering does not control every input. The app explicitly relocates its config/home, disables auto memory and uses strict MCP config. Managed policy still has its own scope.
